commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
inv = json.loads(Path(\"project/recovery-inventory.json\").read_text())
buf = bytes.fromhex(inv[\"retained_sample\"][\"value_hex\"])
pos = 5

def read_long():
    global pos
    value = shift = 0
    while True:
        b = buf[pos]
        pos += 1
        value |= (b & 127) << shift
        if b < 128:
            return (value >> 1) "'^ -(value & 1)
        shift += 7

def read_string():
    global pos
    n = read_long()
    assert n >= 0
    value = buf[pos:pos+n].decode("utf-8")
    assert len(buf[pos:pos+n]) == n
    pos += n
    return value

account = read_string()
currency = read_string()
amount = read_long()
ledger = inv["retained_sample"]["source_ledger"]
assert buf[0] == 0 and int.from_bytes(buf[1:5], "big") == 42
assert pos == len(buf)
assert (account, currency, amount) == (ledger["account"], ledger["currency"], ledger["amount_minor"])
assert Decimal(amount) / 100 == Decimal(ledger["amount_decimal"])
print(json.dumps({"check": "offline byte inspection using supplied historical layout; no SDK or service", "magic": buf[0], "schema_id": int.from_bytes(buf[1:5], "big"), "account": account, "currency": currency, "amount_long": amount, "historical_usd": str(Decimal(amount) / 100), "if_misinterpreted_as_micro_usd": str(Decimal(amount) / 1000000), "trailing_bytes": len(buf)-pos}))
'"'"
